title: Hindsight Pulse: request annotator for error funnel and payload forensics
creator: Priya Patel
description: Design a compact, scannable inspector that surfaces failed requests and retry behaviour across a timeline (the 'Hindsight Pulse'). The component should let SREs and engineers quickly triage a failed LLM request by exposing an annotated error funnel, retry lineage, error taxonomy tags, and a lightweight payload forensic view with side-by-side diffs for inputs and model outputs. Must fit into the existing request detail panel and be usable in narrow sidebars, as an expanded modal, and as an embeddable quickcard on dashboards. Success metrics: time-to-root-cause (target 30% reduction), % of incidents resolved without backend repro, and initial usability score >= 85 in internal dogfood tests.
acceptance_criteria: Pulse shows chronological events (attempts, fallbacks, model swaps) with timestamps and latencies
Inline error taxonomy badges (network, kv-cache-miss, model-safety, truncated-input, timeout) with one-click filter
Payload inspector supports JSON tree + raw view + side-by-side diff for last two attempts
Retry lineage visually connects attempts and annotates why each retry happened (policy/automatic/canary)
Performance: full inspector open under 250ms for payloads <= 50KB; initial render progressive for larger payloads
Accessible per Redwood color contrast and keyboard navigation patterns
technical_constraints: Payloads are often large—render progressively and avoid blocking main thread
Must work with existing trace IDs and be linkable from the Console timeline
Should not require additional runtime telemetry; use existing request breadcrumbs and payload snapshots
Authentication: maintain user's current RBAC scoping; don't surface PII unless audit flag present
design_notes: Primary layout is split: left is timeline + funnel, right is payload inspector. For narrow screens use stacked cards.
Use condensed glyphs for attempt states; expand on hover or keyboard focus to show full payload preview
Introduce a small inline 'explain' affordance that surfaces the most likely root-cause (heuristic derived) with confidence score
Prototype includes a toggle to compare 'attempt n' vs 'attempt n-1' and to pin a snapshot for downstream investigation
Consider a preview mode for depersonalized payloads to allow non-privileged team members to triage
review_feedback: 2026-02-18 Miguel Santos (eng): prefer sidecar approach to avoid reflow in request detail. Concern about payload size handling.
2026-02-21 Priya Patel (pm): add taxonomy badge for 'quantization-regression' per recent incident
2026-02-25 Accessibility review: keyboard focus order ok, but need label for diff toggles and ensure aria-live for new events
2026-03-01 Security (Lina Kaur): require blur/obfuscation toggle for PII; add audit log event when inspector viewed in full payload mode
2026-03-03 Eng review (Arielle Novak): implementation strategy agreed—lazy hydrate payload inspector, use worker thread for diffing, reuse existing KV cache view component
2026-03-05 Design critique: iterate microcopy for taxonomy badges and add micro-animations to make retry lineage clearer
decision_log: Keep compact default: timeline and funnel visible, payload collapsed to a 2-line summary to reduce noise
Use expandable sidecar for full forensic view rather than inline expansion to maintain list performance
Implement server-side snapshotting where available; otherwise fallback to client-side cached payloads for last 5 attempts
Visual diffing limited to last two attempts by default to avoid cognitive overload; allow custom selection when inspector expanded
Expose 'annotate' API hook so infra can attach automated labels (eg. safety-flag, policy-fallback) consumed by badges
